newsitem.title: USA: Ciatti's to amend rights offering.
newsitem.headline: Ciatti's to amend rights offering.

text.p: Ciatti's Inc said Friday it intends to file an amendment to its registration statement increasing its rights offering to a three-for-one offering from a two-for-one offering.
Under the revised rights offering, the company will offer a total of 2,228,457 shares of common stock to shareholders.
In connection with the increase, the offering will be made starting November 22 to all holders of record November 15. It will remain open until December 20.
The rights exercise price will remain $3 per share.
Under terms of the offering, each holder of record November 15 will get the right to buy three shares of the company's stock for each share of common stock owned as of the record date.
Ciatti's owns and operates full-service restaurants and is a franchisee of Bruegger's Bagel Bakery restaurants.
